title: Ahsoka Tano Sets Grogu's Path
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: The Mandalorian and Grogu travel to the planet of Corvus in hopes of locating a Jedi that can help them. They meet Ahsoka Tano there, with she and Grogu connecting through the Force. The Mandalorian believes his quest has been fulfilled until Ahsoka refuses to train Grogu. Instead, she sends them to the planet Tython, where Grogu's destiny may well be revealed.
